item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Welcome to my blog. This is the first post, mostly to make sure everything works.

Why a blog?

Because writing things down is a good way to actually learn them. I’ll be posting about projects, tools, and whatever I’m tinkering with at the moment.

What’s next

More posts, hopefully. Thanks for stopping by.
